name: __format__
doc:
Default object formatter.

Return str(self) if format_spec is empty. Raise TypeError otherwise.

name: __init__
doc: Initialize self.  See help(type(self)) for accurate signature.

name: __init_subclass__
doc:
This method is called when a class is subclassed.

The default implementation does nothing. It may be
overridden to extend subclasses.

name: __sizeof__
doc: Size of object in memory, in bytes.

name: __ceil__
doc: Ceiling of an Integral returns itself.

name: __index__
doc: Return self converted to an integer, if self is suitable for use as an index into a list.

name: __round__
doc:
Rounding an Integral returns itself.

Rounding with an ndigits argument also returns an integer.

name: denominator
doc: the denominator of a rational number in lowest terms

name: imag
doc: the imaginary part of a complex number

name: numerator
doc: the numerator of a rational number in lowest terms

name: real
doc: the real part of a complex number

name: __alloc__
doc:
B.__alloc__() -> int

Return the number of bytes actually allocated.

name: __buffer__
doc: Return a buffer object that exposes the underlying memory of the object.

name: __release_buffer__
doc: Release the buffer object that exposes the underlying memory of the object.

name: __bytes__
doc: Convert this value to exact type bytes.

name: __get__
doc: Return an attribute of instance, which is of type owner.

name: __complex__
doc: Convert this value to exact type complex.

name: __reversed__
doc: Return a reverse iterator over the dict keys.

name: __getformat__
doc:
You probably don't want to use this function.

  typestr
    Must be 'double' or 'float'.

name: __exit__
doc: Release the underlying buffer exposed by the memoryview object.

name: c_contiguous
doc: A bool indicating whether the memory is C contiguous.

name: contiguous
doc: A bool indicating whether the memory is contiguous.

name: f_contiguous
doc: A bool indicating whether the memory is Fortran contiguous.

name: format
doc:
A string containing the format (in struct module style)
for each element in the view.

name: itemsize
doc: The size in bytes of each element of the memoryview.

name: nbytes
doc:
The amount of space in bytes that the array would use in
a contiguous representation.

name: ndim
doc:
An integer indicating how many dimensions of a multi-dimensional
array the memory represents.

name: readonly
doc: A bool indicating whether the memory is read only.

name: shape
doc:
A tuple of ndim integers giving the shape of the memory
as an N-dimensional array.

name: strides
doc:
A tuple of ndim integers giving the size in bytes to access
each element for each dimension of the array.

name: suboffsets
doc: A tuple of integers used internally for PIL-style arrays.

name: __set__
doc: Set an attribute of instance to value.

name: __set_name__
doc: Method to set name of a property.

name: __length_hint__
doc: Private method returning an estimate of len(list(it)).

name: __instancecheck__
doc: Check if an object is an instance.

name: __prepare__
doc: Create the namespace for the class statement

name: __subclasscheck__
doc: Check if a class is a subclass.

name: __subclasses__
doc: Return a list of immediate subclasses.
